_comment: Scenarios for scripts/replay-eval.py, against scripts/replay-fixture (a filing site). Each item is one person's return. `learn` teaches the skill once with the full agent; the other scenarios replay it. Checks read what the fixture actually received.

scenarios.why: the skill's own data, page unchanged: replay should be instant and need no model
other people: different values, an optional section, 2–3 deduction rows
renamed buttons, new ids, reordered fields, a cookie banner and a survey popup
only names are given: every value comes from each person's vault folder (one capital gains statement is a scan)

scenarios.ask: file this year's Acme Filing tax returns for {names} from their documents
scenarios.why: an everyday request, no skill named: smart replay should pick the skill itself and read each person's documents

documents._comment: Written into <vault>/replay-eval/<item>/ for the documents scenario and removed afterwards. scan: rendered as an image-only PDF, so only OCR can read it.
